integration.route: designer route kept; local repair around each trimmed tap

sections.label: Intro
sections.note: Sweep: two long straights and one big L on the sunny rooftop (L0).

sections.label: Hook A
sections.note: Staircase cluster NE on the bass entry, then a sawtooth zigzag (NE/NW legs every 4-5 taps) between roof blocks.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.note: Switchbacks along the roof-court walls: lanes on the long vocal gaps, rungs on the short ones; narrow road 1.8; a roof-court passage wraps the road.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 1
sections.note: Sky bridge B1: one long SE staircase climbing +4 over the void.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.note: Rotating staircase that wraps the MV football pitch (SE -> SW -> NW legs); stands unfold; one fake fork ends in a broken edge.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.note: Drop -4 at the end of chorus 1, then a square spiral that climbs +18 around the window clock tower (laps pass over each other), then switchbacks down the tower wall and through the window arcade.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 2
sections.note: Tight sawtooth corridor (legs of 3-4 taps), narrow road 1.7, ramping down -6; five amber windows easter egg.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.note: Drop -4, then a wide zigzag that passes OVER the hook and verse-1 roofs (multi-level crossings), terraces fan open.

sections.label: Final chorus
sections.note: Staircase loop around the bunny relief (four diagonal legs) while climbing +6, crossing above the verse-1 switchbacks; one 3-tap 16th figure on the audible snare fill.

sections.label: Outro
sections.note: Drop -5 onto the cover square level, long release sweeps and a last pair of switchbacks into the deep-blue finish.
